connector.name: Databricks MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: 263 tools for Databricks: Unity Catalog, SQL, Compute, Jobs, Serving, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package databricks-sdk-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pramodbhatofficial account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: DATABRICKS_TOKEN
env.description: Databricks personal access token or OAuth token

env.name: DATABRICKS_MCP_TOOLS_INCLUDE
env.description: Comma-separated list of tool modules to load (e.g. unity_catalog,sql,compute). Leave empty to load all 263 tools.
